Chicken shish (yogurt marinade)
600 g chicken breast
1 dessert spoon thyme, chilli flakes, salt
1 pepper, 1 onion
Dice the chicken and marinate in the yogurt, tomato paste, oil and spices for at least 1 hour.
Thread the chicken and vegetables onto skewers.
Cook on a grill or in the oven at 220 °C for 15 minutes, turning.
The internal temperature should be 74 °C.
Serve with lavash and sumac onions.
Soak wooden skewers in water for 30 minutes.
Chicken sauté (with tomatoes and peppers)
Sear the chicken over high heat.
Add the onion and pepper and sauté for 5 minutes.
Don’t crowd the chicken.
Oven-baked chicken legs with potatoes
8 chicken drumsticks
1 dessert spoon thyme, sweet paprika, salt
Rub the chicken with oil, tomato paste and spices.
Coarsely chop the potatoes and onion.
Arrange on the tray and add 1 glass of water.
Bake at 200 °C for 50 minutes.
Turn halfway.
The chicken near the bone must not stay pink.
With salad.
Boiled chicken and vegetable soup
1 chicken leg and breast
Half a cup vermicelli
8 cups water
Boil the chicken in water and skim off the foam.
Cook for 45 minutes, remove the chicken and shred it.
Add the chopped vegetables to the broth and cook for 15 minutes.
Add the vermicelli and chicken and cook for 8 minutes.
Once the broth cools, skim off the fat on top.
Chicken tantuni
500 g chicken breast (thin strips)
1 dessert spoon chilli flakes, cumin, salt
Cook the chicken with the spices over high heat for 8 minutes.
Finely dice the tomato, add and cook for 3 minutes.
Warm the lavash in a pan.
Wrap with the chicken, sumac onions and parsley.
Warm the lavash by pressing it into the chicken juices.
Circassian chicken
1 chicken breast
2 slices stale bread
1.5 cups walnuts
Boil and shred the chicken; keep the broth.
Soak the bread in the broth.
Blitz the walnuts, bread and garlic in a food processor and thin with broth to a cream consistency.
Mix half the chicken with the sauce.
Drizzle with paprika heated in butter.
Use fresh walnuts so they don’t taste bitter.
As a cold meze.
Chicken casserole
600 g chicken thighs (boneless)
Coarsely chop all the vegetables.
Arrange them in the casserole dish with the chicken.
Add oil, salt and thyme.
Add 1 glass of water and cover.
Put in a cold oven and bake at 190 °C for 60 minutes.
Putting the casserole into a cold oven keeps it from cracking.
Breaded chicken (oven-baked)
4 chicken breasts (flattened)
1 cup breadcrumbs
Coat the chicken in flour, egg, then the breadcrumb–parmesan mix.
Arrange on a lined tray and drizzle with oil.
Bake for 20 minutes, turning halfway.
Oven-breaded chicken has far less fat than fried.
Lemon and thyme chicken wings
1 kg chicken wings
Leave the wings in the marinade for 1 hour.
Arrange on a wire rack.
Bake for 40 minutes, turning halfway.
Serve with lemon slices.
The wire rack lets the wings brown on all sides.
Chicken with peas
Dice the chicken and sear it.
Add the onion, carrot and tomato paste.
Add the peas and 1.5 glasses of hot water.
Serve with dill.
Chickpeas with meat (baked in a casserole)
2 cups chickpeas (soaked)
300 g diced meat
Pre-boil the chickpeas for 40 minutes.
Fry the meat in butter, then add the onion and tomato paste.
Put the chickpeas, meat and water in the casserole dish.
Bake at 190 °C for 50 minutes.
Slow cooking in a casserole makes the chickpeas creamy.
Fresh borlotti beans in olive oil
500 g fresh borlotti beans
Add the carrot and potato.
Add the beans and tomatoes.
Cook with 1.5 glasses of hot water over low heat for 40 minutes.
Shell the fresh borlotti beans from their pods.
Zucchini stuffed with lentils
6 zucchini
1 dessert spoon mint, salt
Mix the lentils, rice, grated onion, tomato paste and spices.
Stuff the zucchini.
Arrange in a pot and add 2 glasses of hot water and oil.
Cook over low heat for 40 minutes.
You can use the zucchini flesh in a lentil soup.
Chickpea and onion stew over rice
Slice the onions thinly and cook slowly in butter for 10 minutes.
Add the chickpeas and water.
Cook over low heat for 30 minutes.
Serve over rice.
The sweetness of the onion is what gives the stew its flavour.
Fried lentils (with bulgur)
Half a cup bulgur
Boil the lentils for 20 minutes.
Add the bulgur and cook for 10 more minutes; drain.
Fry the onions in oil until browned.
Mix the lentils and bulgur with the onions.
Caramelised onions give the flavour.
Hummus vegetable plate
2 cups hummus
1 dessert spoon sumac
Cut the vegetables into strips and fry in oil in a pan for 8 minutes.
Spread the hummus on a plate.
